_note: Every source here is UNVERIFIED: the publishers could not be reached from the environment where this was written, and the feed addresses are the usual WordPress or documented-API ones. Run `npm run desk:check` from a machine with open internet (or run the workflow once by hand) to see which answer. Fix or disable the ones that do not. Types: rss (RSS or Atom), federal-register (JSON API). `needs` lists the keyword groups from keywords.json that an item must contain; `weight` is added to the score. Check each publisher's terms before relying on a feed; the desk keeps only titles, links, dates, and 280-character snippets.

sources.name: Connect CRE
sources.note: Runs the weekly 'Return to Lender' column. Most hotel items sit inside that column, so a hotel match may come from a body snippet.

sources.name: CRE Daily
sources.note: Carries the Trepp and KBRA pickups.

sources.name: The Real Deal
sources.note: Heavy on court filings. Expect the names-party flag often.

sources.name: Lodging Magazine
sources.note: Carries the CoStar weekly results write-ups.

sources.name: Federal Register: bank regulators on CRE
sources.note: Documented public API. Guidance and rules that change how banks classify or reserve against CRE loans.

sources.name: Hospitality Net
sources.note: Carries HVS reports and many press releases. Find the RSS address on the site, then enable.

sources.name: Hotel Online
sources.note: Carries the CoStar weekly write-ups. Find the RSS address, then enable.

sources.name: Bisnow (hotel)
sources.note: Hotel vertical. Find the RSS address, then enable.

sources.name: Google Alerts feeds
sources.note: Create alerts (delivery: RSS feed) for: hotel receivership; hotel loan sale; hotel foreclosure auction; special servicer hotel. Add one source entry per feed address.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR: hotel REITs and brands
sources.note: SEC requires a real contact in the request. Set the DESK_CONTACT secret, add one entry per company from its EDGAR filings atom feed (8-K and 10-Q), and look up the company numbers yourself. None are listed here because they were not verified.

sources.name: CourtListener alerts
sources.note: Needs an account. Create a docket or search alert for hotel receiverships and add its feed address.
